name: Aihara Hiroki
source:
Misato's student, a quiet boy. With long hair and a skirt, he looks just like a girl, but he's a genuine boy. Like Yuta, he's already been touched by Nanana.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=698875&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
